AAg.caption: Capturing User (Opt in)
AAg.doc: if you want opt the user back in, set this to `true`.
AAg.name: isOptIn

AAh.caption: OPT User Out  _________________________________________________________
AAh.doc: You can use this action to opt users out based on your cookie settings definition (e.g. preferences set via a cookie banner).
AAh.name: opt_user_out

AAi.caption: Note _________________________________________________________
AAi.doc: This is also the suggested way to prevent capturing any data from the admin on the page, as well as from team members of your organization.
AAi.name: note
